brief:
Aid organizations say US President Donald Trump's Gaza peace initiative has collapsed, leaving two million Palestinians confined to an area of less than 130 square kilometers, according to Al Jazeera English. The groups characterize the situation as "displacement by design," pointing to the plan's inability to address the humanitarian crisis in the besieged territory.

A UN-backed framework underpinning the peace effort has broken down, the aid groups reported. The outcome leaves the densely populated enclave facing severe constraints on movement and access to resources for its civilian population.
dek: With two million Palestinians confined to an area of less than 130sq km, UN-backed Gaza peace plan has collapsed.
title: Aid groups declare Trump Gaza plan failed after collapse
